Body.Content:
This feature extends support for the Standard Audit File for Tax (SAF-T) format to Austria, allowing customers in this coumtry to generate audit files using the established SAF-T framework. Key capabilities include:

Enable SAF-T audit file generation for companies operating in Austria.

Reuse the existing SAF-T W1 implementation to support additional country-specific compliance scenarios.

Provide a standardized electronic audit file format that can be shared with tax authorities and auditors when required.

Simplify multinational compliance processes by using a consistent audit reporting approach across supported countries.

By extending an existing SAF-T capability to additional markets, organizations benefit from a more unified compliance experience while reducing the need for separate audit file solutions for each country.

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
